transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the importance of ethical and compliance requirements in our ATM system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, while RES-02 provides transparent transaction logs for accountability. RES-03 prevents negative balances, safeguarding user interests. RES-04 secures user identity through a PIN mechanism, promoting fairness. RES-05 and RES-06 ensure responsible fund management and timely user notifications, aligning with social responsibility. Lastly, RES-07 emphasizes data privacy, which is critical for user trust and compliance.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I prioritize the safety and reliability of the ATM system. SAF-01 ensures accounts do not have negative balances, while SAF-02 guarantees that funds are automatically withdrawn from savings when checking accounts are insufficient, enhancing reliability. transcript.statement: As the EfficiencyAgent, I emphasize the need for high performance and resource optimization in the ATM system. transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I emphasize the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-05 offers clients an electronic transaction record option, reducing paper waste. GRN-06 ensures energy savings by shutting down during inactivity. requirements.text: The system shall ensure all transactions are encrypted and comply with financial regulations.
The system shall implement user authentication using a secure PIN mechanism and ensure user privacy.
The system shall log all transactions with timestamps for audit purposes.
The system shall prevent transactions that would result in negative account balances.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.
The system shall ensure transactions are processed within 3 seconds for user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The system shall ensure automatic fund withdrawal from savings accounts only when sufficient funds are available.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.

Synthesis allows for transaction speed while considering energy-efficient processing.
